title: 第3章 凝聚剑灵
content_zh:
废物功法？海天还是第一次听到这样的说法。

就连边上的小雨以及其他的旁系子弟们都瞪大着眼睛。很明显，他们心里都想不通。为什么一本天阶功法居然会被家主称为废物功法？

所有人将目光集中在了海无涯的身上。

瞥了一眼期盼的海天，海无涯坐了下来，《九天神剑诀》上面的灰尘即使被海天拍掉不少，可依然积攒了厚厚的一层。

“传说这本《九天神剑诀》是以前一位剑神前辈所著的修炼功法，后来因缘巧合被我们海家的前辈给得到了。当时海家前辈们都认为这是老天赐给我们海家的机遇，有了这本《九天神剑诀》，绝对可以让我们海家腾飞的。”

众人并没有打扰海无涯，都静静的站立着听他诉说着海家的辛秘。

“虽然这本《九天神剑诀》只是一部残缺的功法，可是最高也能够修炼到剑皇境界。当时海家的前辈们立即找来了年轻一代尚未开始修炼的子弟们，传授给了他们这本功法。一年过去了，修炼的十名年轻一代子弟们，最差的一名也达到了八段剑之力！”

“什么？一年八段剑之力？”众人都惊呼起来。

剑之力，是在剑者达到剑士之前的级别，算是过渡阶段。分为一段到九段剑之力。

要知道，即使现在海家年轻一代天赋最好的海云修炼了三年也才六段剑之力，而当初那些海家子弟们，最差的一个也达到了八段剑之力。

海天没有跟随众人一起惊呼，反而是微微皱起了眉头。天阶级别的功法，能够让人一年之内修炼到八段剑之力并不奇怪。只是这为什么会称为废物功法？

“可是大伯，那为什么会被称为废物功法呢？”小雨将在场众人心里的疑问都给问了出来。

和蔼的摸了摸小雨的脑袋，海无涯抬起头继续说道：“紧接着，意想不到的事情发生了。那些年轻子弟们，在接下来的日子里，便再无寸进。凡是达到了九段剑之力的，没有一个人能够成为一名正式剑者，达到一星剑士。”

“一个人都没有吗？”海天紧皱着眉头问道。

“对，一个人都没有。”海无涯点了点头继续说道，“一开始家族前辈们还以为是那些子弟们的天赋有问题。可是一年过去了，两年过去了，三年过去了，那些子弟们，还是一点进步都没有。全部都停留在九段剑之力这个门槛上。”

这话一出，小雨和那些个旁系子弟们都惊讶的张大了嘴巴。

就连海天的眉头也是越皱越紧，他还从未听说过这样奇特的事情。身为天阶功法的《九天神剑诀》，居然连让人达到一星剑士都没有办法。难道说这本是冒牌的吗？

不对，如果是假冒的话，那么那十名年轻子弟，一开始绝对不会有这样的修炼速度。肯定是这修炼的中间出了问题。

“父亲，我想先把这本功法拿回去看看。”海天沉吟了一会儿，便抬头道。

“我都说成这样了，你还要把它拿回去？”海无涯的声音渐渐冷了下来，他已经把话说的这样明白了，为何海天还不听话，回去重选一本？

可海天他有自己的想法，他曾经也是一名剑神，无论是见识还是经验都比这里的人强太多了。那些海家前辈们研究不出来的事情，他可未必研究不出来。

“是的，我只是想先研究一下，看看这其中到底有何奥秘。”海天再次说道。

望了一眼海天那倔强的神情，海无涯有些错愕。不过他还是点了点头：“既然这样的话，那么你就先拿回去研究下吧。不过你现在再给我去选一本修炼功法来。”在海无涯心中，即便海天拿回去了，也不可能研究出任何东西来。

听了海无涯那颇为严肃的语气，海天明白如果自己不重新选择一本修炼功法的话，恐怕海无涯是不会让他把这本残缺的废物功法给带走的。

出于无奈，海天很快便按照进门的时候海无涯告诉他的，在第三排第五层找到了那本黄阶高级功法。

见到海无涯脸上那满意的笑容，海天终于是松了口气。

全部登记完毕之后，海无涯站起身来：“好了，现在你们就开始在隔壁的房间进行抄录吧。全部抄录完毕之后便将那功法给放回原处。晚上的时候我过来检查。”

其他人一个个都兴奋的拿着早已准备好的纸笔，跑到了隔壁的房间开始抄录他们所选择的修炼功法。

海天却是将他所选择的黄阶高级功法给扔在了桌子上，让小雨代为照看。他自己则是带着那本残缺的《九天神剑诀》离开了。

“天哥！你不抄录到哪去啊？”小雨见海天要厉害，立即高叫起来。

“我现在回去研究一下，下午再过来。小雨你先帮我看着那本功法，别让别人动了。”海天头也不回的说道。

一向和海天关系不错的小雨，自然不会推诿。只是他心里实在不明白，海天对那本废物功法有什么好研究的？

回到了房间的海天，立即将门窗全部关闭起来。

相比起刚开始看到《九天神剑诀》的激动兴奋，他现在显得无比的沉稳以及疑惑。

一本堂堂的天阶级别的功法，怎么会出现这样的情况？他不解，仔细的开始翻阅起来。

翻开那尘封了多年的废物功法，海天的心思立即全部转移了上去。可是过了一段时间，他却是合上了功法站立了起来，紧皱着眉头来回走动着：“奇怪，没有哪里不对呀，怎么会达不到一星剑士呢？”

无论他怎么想都没有觉得有任何问题。但是一旦他认定的事情，他就会不遗余力的去做。

“看样子，想要破解这本‘废物功法’上的秘密，就只有亲自一试了！”海天脸上挂着一丝淡淡的笑容。

自从他成为剑神以后，几乎就没有遇到这么有挑战性的事情了。他那凝固已久的血液，终于又开始沸腾起来。

“来吧！就让我揭开你这‘废物功法’的真面目吧！”海天自信一笑，立即盘膝而坐，按照着残缺的《九天神剑诀》上所记载的方法开始修炼起来。

即便他已经不是第一次修炼了，却依然感到了体内的兴奋。

磅礴的天地灵气，开始缓缓的进入了海天的体内。乳白色的雾气，正在海天的头顶之上不断的盘旋。

这些乳白色的雾气，正是那高浓度的天地灵气。

这些天地灵气一直存在于空气中。可是浓度却十分的稀薄，所以平常人们几乎用肉眼看不出来。可海天却是用了一种特殊的手法，让自己身体方圆十米的天地灵气疯狂凝聚过来，形成了高浓度的乳白色雾气。

一缕缕乳白色的雾气，犹如在森林里欢跳的精灵，迅速进入了海天的身体内部，顺着他的经脉，开始不断的流转，并且最终汇聚到了下丹田中。

感受到下丹田内那越聚越多的白色雾气，海天明白，那些高浓度的天地灵气，已经被他转化为了自身的剑灵力。

剑灵力，便是剑者体内修炼而来的能量。剑者一切的手段，几乎全是由剑灵力来操控完成的。

就在一切都有条不紊的开始进行的时候，海天突然感觉到一股磅礴的天地灵气竟然不受他的控制开始疯狂的涌入。

这突如其来的情况并没有困扰海天，他以前在修炼的时候，早就已经遇到过多次。他努力的控制着那为数不多的剑灵力，尽量延缓那天地灵气的涌入。

如果是以前的话，这个方法肯定会成功的。

可是海天忘记了一件事情，他已经不是过去那个拥有雄浑剑灵力的剑神，而是一个刚刚才开始修炼的小菜鸟。

就凭他那微薄的剑灵力，怎么可能阻挡的住磅礴的天地灵气？

感受着那天地灵气疯狂的涌入，海天脸色一变，即使是他也感到麻烦了。如果再任由天地灵气这么疯狂进入的话，那么用不了多长时间，他的身体便会被这天地灵气给撑爆！

好不容易得来的身体，让他的灵魂有了寄宿之地，怎么可能就这样随随便便的再次失去？

在心里不甘的狂吼一声，想要控制这些天地灵气，最好的办法就是把它们全部转化为自己的剑灵力。可就凭他现在这样的转化速度，又怎么跟得上天地灵气进入的速度？

早晚有一天，他的身体便将会撑爆！

怎么办？到底该怎么办？海天心中焦急万分。

忽然他灵机一动，想到了一个方法。既然他控制不了这天地灵气的进入，那么便索性开始凝聚剑灵！

剑灵，是正式剑者的标志，也是一名剑者的绝对核心。因为剑灵里面隐藏着剑者的灵魂，一旦灵魂受到损伤，那么即便拥有再好的丹药，再强的实力，也逃不过陨落的结果。

然而，一般只有在九段剑之力冲击一星剑士的时候，才会开始凝聚剑灵。

海天又何尝不知道？可他现在已经没有办法去想这么多了。
content_en:
Waste technique?This was the first time Haitian heard such a statement.

Even Xiaoyu and the other disciples beside him stared wide-eyed.It was obvious that they couldn't figure it out.Why is a heaven-level skill called a useless skill by the family owner?

Everyone focused their attention on Hai Wuya.

After glancing at Hai Tian who was looking forward to it, Hai Wuya sat down. Even though a lot of dust on the "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art" was knocked off by Hai Tian, ​​it still accumulated a thick layer.

"It is said that this "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art" is a practice method written by a former sword god senior. Later, by chance, it was obtained by our seniors of the Hai family. At that time, the Hai family seniors all thought that this was an opportunity given to our Hai family by God. With this "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art", our Hai family can definitely take off."

Everyone did not disturb Hai Wuya, and stood quietly listening to him tell the secrets of the Hai family.

"Although this "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Technique" is only an incomplete technique, it can be cultivated to the highest level of the Sword Emperor. At that time, the seniors of the Hai family immediately found the younger generation of disciples who had not yet begun to practice, and taught them this technique. One year has passed, and among the ten disciples of the younger generation who have practiced, the worst one has also reached the power of the eighth-level sword!"

"What? The power of eight levels of swords in one year?" Everyone exclaimed.

The power of the sword is the level before the swordsman reaches the swordsman level, which is considered a transitional stage.It is divided into one to nine levels of sword power.

You must know that even Hai Yun, who is the most talented among the younger generation of the Hai family, only has the power of the sixth-level sword after three years of training. At the time, the worst one among the Hai family's disciples had only reached the power of the eighth-level sword.

Hai Tian did not join the crowd in exclaiming, but instead frowned slightly.It’s not surprising that heaven-level skills can allow people to practice eight levels of sword power within a year.But why is this called a waste technique?

"But uncle, why is it called a waste technique?" Xiaoyu asked all the questions in the minds of everyone present.

After touching Xiaoyu's head kindly, Hai Wuya raised his head and continued: "Then, something unexpected happened. Those young disciples made no progress in the following days. No one who has reached the power of the nine-level sword can become an official swordsman or reach the level of a one-star swordsman."

"Is there no one there?" Hai Tian asked with a frown.

"Yes, there is no one." Hai Wuya nodded and continued, "At first, the family seniors thought there was something wrong with the talents of the disciples. But one year has passed, two years have passed, three years have passed, and those disciples still have not made any progress at all. They all stay at the threshold of the power of the nine-stage sword."

As soon as these words came out, Xiaoyu and the other disciples opened their mouths in surprise.

Even Hai Tian's brows furrowed more and more tightly. He had never heard of such a strange thing.As a heaven-level skill, the "Nine Heavenly Divine Sword Technique" can't even make people reach a one-star swordsman.Could it be that this book is fake?

No, if it was a fake, then those ten young disciples would never have practiced at such a speed in the beginning.There must be something wrong during this practice.

"Father, I want to take this skill back and look at it first." Hai Tian pondered for a while, then raised his head and said.

"I've said this, and you still want to take it back?" Hai Wuya's voice gradually became colder. He had already made it clear. Why didn't Hai Tian listen and go back to choose another book?

But Hai Tian has his own ideas. He was once a sword god, and his knowledge and experience are much better than those here.He may not be able to study things that the seniors of the Hai family cannot study.

"Yes, I just want to do some research first to see what the mystery is." Hai Tian said again.

Looking at Hai Tian's stubborn expression, Hai Wuya was a little stunned.But he still nodded: "If that's the case, then you can take it back and study it first. But now you can choose a practice method for me." In Hai Wuya's heart, even if Hai Tian takes it back, it is impossible to study anything.

After listening to Hai Wuya's rather serious tone, Hai Tian understood that if he didn't choose a new cultivation method, Hai Wuya might not let him take away this incomplete useless method.

Out of helplessness, Hai Tian quickly followed what Hai Wuya told him when he entered the door and found the yellow-level advanced technique on the fifth floor of the third row.

Seeing the satisfied smile on Hai Wuya's face, Hai Tian finally breathed a sigh of relief.

After everything was registered, Hai Wuya stood up and said: "Okay, now you can start transcribing in the next room. After all the transcribing is completed, put the exercises back to their original places. I will come over to check them in the evening."

Everyone else excitedly took the paper and pen they had prepared and ran to the next room to start transcribing the exercises they had chosen.

However, Hai Tian threw the Huang-level advanced technique he chose on the table and asked Xiao Yu to take care of it.He himself left with the incomplete "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art".

"Brother Tian! Where can you go if you don't copy it?" Xiao Yu shouted immediately when she saw that Hai Tian was going to be powerful.

"I will go back and study it now and come back in the afternoon. Xiaoyu, please help me read the exercise book first and don't let others touch it." Hai Tian said without looking back.

Xiaoyu, who has always had a good relationship with Haitian, will naturally not push the envelope.It's just that he really doesn't understand. What can Hai Tian learn about that useless exercise?

Hai Tian returned to the room and immediately closed all the doors and windows.

Compared to the excitement he felt when he first saw "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Art", he now seems extremely calm and confused.

How could such a situation happen to a majestic heaven-level technique?He was puzzled and began to read through it carefully.

After opening the useless technique that had been covered in dust for many years, Hai Tian's thoughts immediately shifted.But after a while, he closed the technique and stood up, frowning and walking back and forth: "It's strange, there is nothing wrong. How can you not reach the level of a one-star swordsman?"

No matter what he thought, he didn't see anything wrong.But once he decides on something, he will spare no effort to do it.

"It seems that if you want to decipher the secrets of this 'waste technique', you have to try it yourself!" Hai Tian had a faint smile on his face.

Ever since he became the Sword God, he has rarely encountered anything so challenging.His long-coagulated blood finally began to boil again.

"Come on! Let me reveal the true face of your 'waste technique'!" Hai Tian smiled confidently, immediately sat cross-legged and started practicing according to the method recorded in the incomplete "Nine Heavens Divine Sword Technique".

Even though it was not the first time for him to practice, he still felt the excitement in his body.

The majestic spiritual energy of heaven and earth began to slowly enter Hai Tian's body.Milky white mist is constantly hovering above the head of the sea and sky.

These milky white mist are the high concentration of spiritual energy of heaven and earth.

These auras of heaven and earth have always existed in the air.However, the concentration is very thin, so ordinary people can hardly see it with the naked eye.But Hai Tian used a special technique to condense the aura of heaven and earth within a ten-meter radius of his body, forming a highly concentrated milky white mist.

Wisps of milky white mist, like elves dancing happily in the forest, quickly entered Hai Tian's body, began to flow continuously along his meridians, and finally gathered in the lower dantian.

Feeling the white mist gathering in his lower dantian, Hai Tian understood that the high concentration of heaven and earth spiritual energy had been transformed into his own sword spiritual power.

Sword spiritual power is the energy cultivated in the swordsman's body.Almost all the swordsman's methods are controlled by the sword's spiritual power.

Just when everything was going smoothly, Hai Tian suddenly felt a majestic spiritual energy from heaven and earth flowing in crazily out of his control.

This sudden situation did not bother Hai Tian. He had encountered it many times before when he was practicing.He worked hard to control the few sword spiritual powers and try to delay the influx of spiritual energy from heaven and earth.

If it were the past, this method would definitely be successful.

But Hai Tian forgot one thing. He was no longer the sword god with powerful sword spiritual power in the past, but a newbie who had just started practicing.

How could his meager sword spiritual power be able to block the majestic spiritual energy of heaven and earth?

Feeling the crazy influx of spiritual energy from heaven and earth, Hai Tian's expression changed. Even he felt that he was in trouble.If he continues to allow the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to enter so crazily, it won't take long for his body to be burst by the spiritual energy of heaven and earth!

The body he finally obtained gave his soul a place to stay. How could he lose it so casually again?

I roared unwillingly in my heart. If I want to control these heaven and earth spiritual energies, the best way is to convert them all into my own sword spiritual power.But with his current transformation speed, how can he keep up with the speed of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth entering?

Sooner or later, his body will burst!

what to do?What should we do?Hai Tian was extremely anxious.

Suddenly he had an idea and thought of a way.Since he couldn't control the entry of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, he simply started to condense the sword spirit!

The sword spirit is the symbol of a formal swordsman and the absolute core of a swordsman.Because the soul of the swordsman is hidden in the sword spirit. Once the soul is damaged, no matter how good the elixir is or how powerful it is, it will not escape the result of death.

However, generally the sword spirit will only begin to gather when the power of the nine-level sword impacts the one-star swordsman.

How could Haitian not know?But he has no way to think so much now.
